candidates.change_summary: Move the balances[msg.sender]=0; assignment before the external call, preventing reentrancy from draining multiple times and changing balances visible after withdraw.
Remove the require on the call result so that failed sends do not revert and balances are set to zero regardless, changing post-withdraw balances observable externally.
Remove the reentrancy lock by deleting the require and lock semantics, allowing reentrant calls that can alter balances seen after withdraw.
Move the balances[msg.sender]=0; line to before the external call so withdraw clears balance before sending (prevents reentrancy-based extra transfers).
Remove the zeroing of balances so the contract keeps the balance after withdraw (allowing repeated withdrawals).
Change the call to use transfer (which reverts on failure but forwards fixed 2300 gas) instead of low-level call.
Remove the reentrancy lock by deleting the locking require and assignments so modifier no longer prevents reentrant entry.
